description: HITL required — data exfiltration detected, CRAT approval gate mandatory
evidence_text: SIEM incident detected: category=data_exfil severity=critical. Pod omni-analyst-5b7d4 in namespace multi-agent is exfiltrating data. Outbound transfer: 45GB in last 2 hours to external IP 185.220.101.5 (known Tor exit node). Transfer rate: 6.25 MB/s sustained. Protocol: HTTPS (port 443). Data pattern matches Redis DUMP files (binary format detected by DPI). Process: python3 with args '/app/src/workers/redis_client.py --export /tmp/dump.rdb'. S3-compatible upload detected to external bucket. Affected keys include: 'omni:kpi:*', 'audit_chain:*', 'omni:baseline_snapshot'. PII and audit chain data may be compromised. CRAT audit trail shows gap in chain at seq 1042-1047 (possible tampering). This incident requires human authorization before any containment action to avoid evidence destruction.
